decision: writes are captured by generated per-table SQLite triggers into an _outbox that stores no values; the push reads current rows

decision: schema evolution is additive only, computed from PRAGMA table_info on both sides; no schema hash or shape version in v1

decision: one /sync call carries the outbox and the cursor; a pulled row with a pending outbox entry is skipped until its write is acked
